page.layout: One page of text, one column: a head line at the top, then a numbered list of questions running down the page. At the foot, a signature at left and the start of item 18 at right.

main_text.head: Et Caput.
main_text.l: 21. An ut fidejussor admittatur in causis criminalibus?
main_text.head: SECTIO SEXTA
CAPUT UNICUM.
main_text.l: 1. Conficiendorum statutorum olim restrictior, quam moribus erat potestas.
13. Statuta dum conduntur à municipiis, omnes oportet esse vocatos, qui sunt de Municipio.
15. Et valent, licet omnes non ad fuerint.
16. Singulorum tamen consensus requiritur, si tale quid exigat statutum.
17. In Senatum municipii, si jus condendi statuta collatum, non opus erit civium praesentia.

page.notes: The large initial C of item 1 is joined to its word. Item 9 and the line "Statuta dum conduntur" are marked as printed. Item 13 appears twice as printed, and item 14 is missing in the print (the numbering goes 13, 13, 15). Item 18 continues on the next page. The head "Et Caput." is the end of a heading begun on the previous page. Some words in the list are faint and may be misread: "familiae" and "Synodi" are copied as they appear.
